  PROBLEM: The canary file content does not match the linked issue specification. The PR instead writes six lines: `status: BROKEN_BY_E2E_BAIT_34330370848`, `run_id: WRONG_VALUE_SHOULD_BE_34330370848`, `updated-by: e2e-bait-injector`, plus two extra key lines and a comment line.
  WHY: The smoke-gate consumer reads this canary and expects the exact byte sequence `status: ok\nrun_id: 34330370848\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n`. Every value is wrong and three forbidden extra lines are present, so any byte-for-byte or line-count verification of the canary fails.
- Requirement: "Update its content so it is exactly these three lines: status: ok / run_id: 34330370848 / updated-by: ai-pipeline" (with a trailing newline after the final line)
  Expected change site: tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff hunk for tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt replaces the old three lines with six lines of bait content (`status: BROKEN_BY_E2E_BAIT_34330370848`, `run_id: WRONG_VALUE_SHOULD_BE_34330370848`, `updated-by: e2e-bait-injector`, `extra: ...`, `also: ...`, and a `# E2E_EDITOR_BAIT_34330370848` comment). No hunk in the PR DIFF produces the required three-line content; the specified `run_id: 34330370848` value appears nowhere as a correct line.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Only modify tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt — do not touch any other file."
  Expected change site: The PR changed-files set should contain exactly one file: tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt. .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt should have no changes.
  Evidence of absence: pr_changed_files.txt lists two files, and the PR diff contains 13 hunks (~114 lines) of additions to .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt (new entries for .claude/hooks/pr_watch_guard.py, analysis reports, ~30 changelog.d fragments, docs/plans/security-pass-convergence-plan.md, scripts/review_merge_train.sh, several tests, and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_watch_guard.py). None of these relate to the canary update; the Copilot review comment on the PR (entry[0], path .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt line 22) flags the same out-of-scope change.
